newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks slide in London as Dow stumbles.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks slide in London as Dow stumbles.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks slid in London as the Dow stumbled after a stronger-than-expected employment report for July, dealers said.
At 1421 GMT, the Hang Seng London Reference index was down 92.17 points to 16,287.05, the day's worst level.

The Dow fell more than 100 points while the U.S. bond market plummeted after government figures revealed a surprisingly robust U.S. labour market. The data raised fears that U.S. interest rates may have to be raised to cool activity.
In Hong Kong, the benchmark Hang Seng index firmed 13.51 points to 16,379.22.
